Search for local minima: multiple starting values

pk_multistart.Rd

Fits the same model from several sets of initial estimates. With oral data only, absorption and disposition rate constants can be confounded ("flip-flop"), and the likelihood can have local minima. Every start is a regular run in the ledger (stage "multistart").

Usage

pk_multistart(
  x,
  starts,
  data = NULL,
  est = NULL,
  fit_fun = NULL,
  quiet = FALSE,
  proj = NULL
)

Arguments

x

A pk_spec, pk_candidate, run reference, or run id.

starts

Tibble with one row per start. Columns are initial values named as the parameters (ka, v2, q, v3, tlag, ...); an optional column set labels the start.

data, est, fit_fun, quiet, proj

See pk_run().

Value

A tibble with one row per start: set, run_id, ofv, the final estimates of the structural parameters, and best (lowest OFV). The best run is attached as attribute best_run.
